events.title: Overnight load persists
events.action: Check the BMS schedule and verify whether an overnight activity was planned.

events.title: Meter stops reporting
events.action: Check gateway connectivity and missing interval backfill.

events.title: Isolated demand spike
events.action: Compare the interval with equipment start logs and neighboring meters.

events.title: HVAC running after hours
events.action: Review the HVAC schedule, overrides, and actual occupancy. Cause requires confirmation.

events.title: Sudden demand spike
events.action: Correlate with large equipment starts. Inspect finer-resolution data if available.

events.title: Telemetry gap
events.action: Check the meter gateway and communications before attributing this to a power outage.

events.title: Expected solar output falls
events.action: Compare inverter telemetry, cloud cover, and curtailment commands.

events.title: Unchanging meter readings
events.action: Verify the meter timestamp and gateway cache; request a fresh reading.

events.title: Unexpected charging peak
events.action: Review charger sessions and the managed charging schedule.

events.title: Baseload gradually rises
events.action: Check persistent equipment loads and compare cooling demand with weather.

events.title: Overnight HVAC load returns
events.action: Check recurring schedule overrides; confirm the change with the facility team.

events.title: Reactive demand increases
events.action: Review reactive power and equipment state. Confirm with suitable power-quality measurements.

events.title: Small overnight increase, first recurrence
events.action: Compare the same overnight window across multiple days.

events.title: Small overnight increase repeats
events.action: Inspect repeated overnight operation; each reading remains below the point limit.

events.title: Third small overnight increase
events.action: Review recurring schedule overrides across nights.

events.title: Persistent modest daytime increase
events.action: Inspect a sustained sequence that individual point limits miss.

events.title: Concurrent recreation meter gap
events.action: Compare other meters before treating this as an isolated device problem.

events.title: Concurrent student center meter gap
events.action: Check for a shared collection or communications problem.

alerts.title: Demand differs from the expected pattern

alerts.hypothesis: A schedule override, extra equipment load, or unplanned occupancy is possible.
alerts.alternatives: A planned operational change or baseline model error may explain the deviation.

context_notes: The demand detector's per-meter point threshold is 6.77. This alert accumulates multiple observations rather than lowering that point threshold.

alerts.hypothesis: A persistent extra load or a change in operating schedule may be developing.
alerts.next_step: Compare equipment schedules and BMS trends with the 3.5-hour lead-in. Check whether an operational change explains the increase.

alerts.explanation: Three consecutive rolling 3-hour windows stayed above the calibrated sequence limit (1.59), with at least ten of twelve signed scores above 0.8 in each window. Every individual reading in the 3.5-hour trigger evidence stayed under its point limit.
alerts.hypothesis: A persistent extra load or a change in operating schedule may be developing.
alerts.next_step: Compare equipment schedules and BMS trends with the 3.5-hour lead-in. Check whether an operational change explains the increase.
alerts.alternatives: Planned occupancy, a legitimate operating change, or baseline model error can create a similar pattern.
alerts.severity_reason: Medium: A smaller deviation, a repeated sequence, or an electrical/data-quality pattern warrants investigation. Priority indicates prototype review urgency, not a confirmed fault or electrical safety rating.
